# Model of graph `example_graph`

Ontology `company` 1.1.0, read module by module. The live source is `graph describe modules --graph example_graph --json`, `graph describe module <module> --graph example_graph --json` and `graph describe type <type> --graph example_graph --json`; it wins when they differ. A module without a page is built in and shared by every graph.

## Modules

| Module | Prefix | Page | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company` | `co` | [company.md](modules/company.md) | The company as a whole, the main module that brings its subject areas together; it holds no terms of its own. |
| `core` | `core` |  | Minimal provenance relations shared by every graph. |
| `operations` | `ops` | [operations.md](modules/operations.md) | How work gets done, the processes, the guidelines that govern them and the training positions need; not who is in the structure. |
| `organization` | `org` | [organization.md](modules/organization.md) | The structure of the company, its units, the positions in them and what they cost; not the people or the work done. |
| `people` | `ppl` | [people.md](modules/people.md) | The people the company knows, who they are and how to reach them; not their positions or units. |
